7ebb2ecc75.en: A workshop-style research retreat read through one deep talk on Continual Learning: Rich Sutton's RL-first view that intelligence is goal-seeking, adaptive and situated in a continuous stream of experience — and why continual, streaming learning (not frozen batch models) is the path to agents that work in a big, non-stationary world.
7ebb2ecc75.zh: 这是一场研讨会形式的研究闭门会，围绕一场关于持续学习的深度演讲展开：Rich Sutton 以强化学习为先的观点认为，智能是追求目标、能够适应、并置身于连续经验流之中的；因此，持续的流式学习（而非冻结的批量模型）才是通向能在庞大、非平稳世界中工作的智能体的道路。

e8d5f28640.en: {1}About:{/1} An invitational retreat of the OpenMind Research Institute — a Canadian non-profit, fully virtual organization whose roadmap is the Alberta Plan for AI Research. This report distills one talk, “Continual Learning,” topic by topic.
e8d5f28640.zh: {1}关于：{/1}这是 OpenMind Research Institute 的一场邀请制研讨会。该机构是加拿大的非营利、完全线上组织，路线图为 Alberta Plan for AI Research。本报告按主题梳理了一场演讲“Continual Learning”。

c7d22db9a5.en: The through-line is Sutton's thesis: the biggest AI advances are still ahead, progress is a marathon, and reinforcement learning — not generative AI — is the path to intelligent agents; the main bottleneck is the lack of effective continual-learning algorithms.
c7d22db9a5.zh: 贯穿全篇的是 Sutton 的论点：AI 最大的进展还在前方，进步是一场马拉松，而强化学习（而非生成式 AI）才是通向智能体的道路；主要瓶颈是缺乏有效的持续学习算法。

76042f01c1.en: OpenMind & the RL-first Bet on Intelligence
76042f01c1.zh: OpenMind 与押注强化学习的智能之路

822f64a951.en: {1}OpenMind Research Institute{/1} · Banff Retreat · Sutton's perspective
822f64a951.zh: {1}OpenMind Research Institute{/1} · 班夫研讨会 · Sutton 的观点

49512d302f.en: Canadian non-profit, fully virtual research institute
49512d302f.zh: 加拿大非营利、完全线上的研究机构

1f4f122883.en: Motto: understand minds well enough to build some — how minds arise from a stream of experience
1f4f122883.zh: 宗旨：深入理解心智，进而构建心智，即心智如何从经验流中产生

02083789d3.en: Roadmap: the Alberta Plan for AI Research
02083789d3.zh: 路线图：Alberta Plan for AI Research

8e79d19bcb.en: Objective: do fundamental research and share it openly with the world
8e79d19bcb.zh: 目标：开展基础研究，并向全世界公开分享

aad7f2b0ea.en: Super-intelligent agents and augmented humans will bring great benefits to the world
aad7f2b0ea.zh: 超级智能的智能体和增强的人类将为世界带来巨大益处

ea85d6c61c.en: The most significant AI advancements are still ahead of us
ea85d6c61c.zh: AI 最重大的进展还在前方

b7c77fbe3a.en: AI development is more of a marathon than a sprint
b7c77fbe3a.zh: AI 的发展更像一场马拉松，而不是短跑

83249a6730.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) — not generative AI — is the key path to developing intelligent agents
83249a6730.zh: 强化学习（RL）而非生成式 AI，是开发智能体的关键路径

d71e12138d.en: The main challenge is the lack of effective learning algorithms
d71e12138d.zh: 主要挑战是缺乏有效的学习算法

b6a197ed57.en: The OpenMind Research Institute — a virtual, non-profit lab behind the Alberta Plan.
b6a197ed57.zh: OpenMind Research Institute：Alberta Plan 背后的线上非营利实验室。

58c1c9126f.en: What Is a Mind? Goal-seeking, Adaptive, Situated
58c1c9126f.zh: 什么是心智？追求目标、能够适应、置身经验之中

c9282c8c87.en: Intelligence is the computational part of the ability to achieve goals (McCarthy & Sutton)
c9282c8c87.zh: 智能是实现目标能力中的计算部分（McCarthy 和 Sutton）

c3278775eb.en: Reward hypothesis: goals & purposes = maximizing the expected cumulative scalar reward
c3278775eb.zh: 奖励假设：目标与意图 = 最大化期望累积标量奖励

f1d327224b.en: Reward-is-enough hypothesis: intelligence and its abilities subserve reward maximization
f1d327224b.zh: 奖励足够假设：智能及其各项能力都服务于奖励最大化

757cb23b6a.en: Biological minds naturally adapt behavior to goals in complex, dynamic environments
757cb23b6a.zh: 生物心智能在复杂、动态的环境中自然地根据目标调整行为

dfc4db64b7.en: Society is comfortable with the adaptive behavior of animals
dfc4db64b7.zh: 社会对动物的适应性行为习以为常

df237cdd3c.en: Most ML / engineering systems are fixed and non-adaptive, built on static models of predefined domains
df237cdd3c.zh: 大多数机器学习 / 工程系统是固定的、不具适应性的，建立在预定义领域的静态模型之上

689ed060bc.en: Biological minds adapt within one ongoing, open stream of experience — not independent data inputs
689ed060bc.zh: 生物心智在一条持续、开放的经验流中进行适应，而不是处理相互独立的数据输入

e27f91daa9.en: Most ML assumes i.i.d. data, making it hard to adapt to real-time, open-world settings
e27f91daa9.zh: 大多数机器学习假设数据独立同分布（i.i.d.），因此难以适应实时、开放世界的环境

7cd0171d71.en: Open-world learning needs online learning, incremental updates and real-time adaptability — not captured by current ML theory
7cd0171d71.zh: 开放世界学习需要在线学习、增量更新和实时适应能力，而这些是当前机器学习理论尚未涵盖的

65ae562900.en: Where do minds sit in AI research? — minds amid generative models, search and computation.
65ae562900.zh: 心智在 AI 研究中处于什么位置？心智位于生成模型、搜索和计算之间。

e3e4a252b1.en: Constant learning: a train phase, then a frozen model used for test
e3e4a252b1.zh: 恒定学习：先有训练阶段，然后使用冻结的模型进行测试

337c624e6d.en: Continual learning: the agent stays in the state–action–reward loop and keeps learning past ‘test’
337c624e6d.zh: 持续学习：智能体始终处于状态–动作–奖励循环中，在“测试”之后仍继续学习

7161603496.zh: 能学习和适应的智能体

449fb6ee24.en: Learning/adapting agents face non-stationary environments — changing data, policies and value functions
449fb6ee24.zh: 学习/适应的智能体面对的是非平稳环境，其数据、策略和价值函数都在变化

570786fd56.en: Reinforcement learning can handle some degree of non-stationarity naturally
570786fd56.zh: 强化学习能够自然地处理一定程度的非平稳性

f3c44bb5a2.en: Continual learning in open environments is a central challenge for minds
f3c44bb5a2.zh: 开放环境中的持续学习是心智面临的核心挑战

6495c3607a.en: Constant vs continual learning — the agent stays in the loop, π keeps updating past ‘test’.
6495c3607a.zh: 恒定学习与持续学习：智能体始终处于循环中，π 在“测试”之后仍持续更新。

fe8e761592.en: A Common Architecture for Continual RL Agents
fe8e761592.zh: 持续强化学习智能体的通用架构

e8c4bf8e22.en: {1}Continual Learning (talk){/1} · the Alberta Plan agent model
e8c4bf8e22.zh: {1}Continual Learning (talk){/1} · Alberta Plan 的智能体模型

fe3d8bc82e.en: Perception — produces the state representation used by all other components
fe3d8bc82e.zh: 感知：生成供所有其他组件使用的状态表示

052e306c3c.en: Reactive policies — quickly produce actions that achieve high reward or features
052e306c3c.zh: 反应式策略：快速产生能获得高奖励或特征的动作

bd739d32bf.en: Value functions — evaluate how well things are going and change the policy (learning)
bd739d32bf.zh: 价值函数：评估事情进展得如何，并改变策略（学习）

1286069920.en: Transition model — predict consequences of alternative choices and change the policy (planning)
1286069920.zh: 转移模型：预测不同选择的后果，并改变策略（规划）

edd07546ca.en: Continual supervised representation / feature finding; continual generalized value-function prediction
edd07546ca.zh: 持续的监督式表示 / 特征发现；持续的广义价值函数预测

b1c0405ec5.en: Continual actor-critic control; planning with reward, search control and exploration
b1c0405ec5.zh: 持续的 actor-critic 控制；结合奖励、搜索控制和探索的规划

7221ae07e5.en: One-step model-based RL with continual function approximation
7221ae07e5.zh: 带有持续函数逼近的单步基于模型的强化学习

fb161e1a40.en: STOMP — Stochastic Trajectory Optimization for Motion Planning
fb161e1a40.zh: STOMP：用于运动规划的随机轨迹优化

a2363e3566.en: Intelligence amplification — enhancing human decision-making with AI
a2363e3566.zh: 智能增强：用 AI 增强人类的决策

2d2b829868.en: A common agent architecture — perception, reactive policies, value functions, transition model.
2d2b829868.zh: 通用的智能体架构：感知、反应式策略、价值函数、转移模型。

a73751bb2d.en: A Little Agent in a Big World

2ff8185be8.en: {1}K. Javed & R. Sutton{/1} · Big World Hypothesis, 2024
2ff8185be8.zh: {1}K. Javed & R. Sutton{/1} · Big World Hypothesis, 2024

4bbca7f9c5.en: The agent is constrained relative to the world: an information-capacity limit = the entropy of agent state, in bits
4bbca7f9c5.zh: 智能体相对于世界是受限的：存在信息容量上限，即智能体状态的熵（以比特计）

4d58514cf7.en: Traditional theory: hone in on good actions and refine over time, with vanishing benefit to exploration
4d58514cf7.zh: 传统理论：锁定好的动作并随时间不断改进，探索的收益逐渐消失

8f67754ac7.en: Small agent, big world ⇒ want more capacity; non-stationary exploration ⇒ acquire info relevant to the future, forget the rest
8f67754ac7.zh: 小智能体、大世界 ⇒ 需要更多容量；非平稳探索 ⇒ 获取与未来相关的信息，忘掉其余部分

a52f26723c.en: Model what matters for decisions: Value-Aware (VAML) & Policy-Aware (PAML) model learning, distributional-equivalent variants
a52f26723c.zh: 只对决策重要的部分建模：价值感知（VAML）与策略感知（PAML）模型学习，以及分布等价的变体

ce6bf2201b.en: Much recent work: Predictron, VPN, TreeQN, GAMPS, value-targeted regression, muZero, value-equivalent sampling
ce6bf2201b.zh: 近期有许多相关工作：Predictron、VPN、TreeQN、GAMPS、value-targeted regression、muZero、value-equivalent sampling

3338f67cee.en: Continual Knowledge Re-Grounding (KnoReG): benefit from an approximate model, then continually correct it against the real world (OS-VI update)
3338f67cee.zh: 持续知识再锚定（KnoReG）：先从近似模型中获益，再持续对照真实世界对其进行修正（OS-VI 更新）

798f4bbf07.en: There are new ways an approximate model of the world can help a small agent
798f4bbf07.zh: 近似的世界模型可以通过新的方式帮助小智能体

9d5f51d54f.en: You are not limited to choosing only an inaccurate or only an accurate model
9d5f51d54f.zh: 你不必只在不准确的模型或只在准确的模型之间二选一

30a90ba0eb.en: A little agent in a big world — the core framing of the Big World Hypothesis.
30a90ba0eb.zh: 大世界中的小智能体：Big World Hypothesis 的核心框架。

ffcaf5be91.en: Efficiency vs Generality: Bias, Compute & the Bitter Lesson
ffcaf5be91.zh: 效率与通用性：偏置、算力与苦涩的教训

5989e2089c.en: {1}R. Sutton — ‘The Bitter Lesson’{/1} · vs the Big World Hypothesis
5989e2089c.zh: {1}R. Sutton — ‘The Bitter Lesson’{/1} · 对比 Big World Hypothesis

d0926780aa.en: A trade-off between generality and sample efficiency
d0926780aa.zh: 通用性与样本效率之间存在权衡

52e369ef44.en: You can improve efficiency by adding bias, at the cost of generality
52e369ef44.zh: 可以通过加入偏置来提高效率，但代价是通用性

4bbce558e6.en: RL defines an extremely general set of problems
4bbce558e6.zh: 强化学习定义了一类极其通用的问题

b4d6ce1be0.en: Add bias to the agent — in conflict with the Bitter Lesson and the Big World Hypothesis
b4d6ce1be0.zh: 给智能体加入偏置，这与 Bitter Lesson 和 Big World Hypothesis 相冲突

863bd16ec1.en: Use more computation — in conflict with the Big World Hypothesis
863bd16ec1.zh: 使用更多计算，这与 Big World Hypothesis 相冲突

139abd03ab.en: Building in knowledge helps short-term and is satisfying, but plateaus and even inhibits progress long-term
139abd03ab.zh: 内置知识短期内有帮助，也令人满意，但长期会遇到瓶颈，甚至阻碍进展

fcd81af3a8.en: Breakthroughs eventually arrive from scaling computation via search and learning
fcd81af3a8.zh: 突破最终来自通过搜索和学习来扩展计算

704337f626.en: The environment is significantly larger and more complex than the agent acting within it
704337f626.zh: 环境比身处其中的智能体大得多、复杂得多

b2e7500487.en: As compute grows, environment complexity grows too — the world stays much larger than the agent (Javed & Sutton, 2024)
b2e7500487.zh: 随着算力增长，环境复杂度也在增长，世界始终比智能体大得多（Javed & Sutton, 2024）

d73fe339b1.en: Efficiency vs generality — adding bias wins short-term; scaling computation wins long-term.
d73fe339b1.zh: 效率与通用性：加入偏置短期占优，扩展计算长期占优。

3ce53e2454.en: {1}M. Elsayed et al.{/1} · “Streaming Deep RL Finally Works”, 2024
3ce53e2454.zh: {1}M. Elsayed et al.{/1} · “Streaming Deep RL Finally Works”, 2024

94a26c5220.en: Classic streaming — TD(λ), Q(λ), SARSA(λ), AC(λ) — do not work with deep networks
94a26c5220.zh: 经典流式方法（TD(λ)、Q(λ)、SARSA(λ)、AC(λ)）不适用于深度网络

17740a7328.en: Batch — PPO, SAC, DQN, Rainbow — do work with deep networks, but need replay buffers
17740a7328.zh: 批量方法（PPO、SAC、DQN、Rainbow）适用于深度网络，但需要回放缓冲区

c80ad36263.en: Natural intelligence processes experience as a continuous stream — sense, act and learn moment-by-moment
c80ad36263.zh: 自然智能把经验作为连续流来处理，时时刻刻感知、行动和学习

a4be4e8a13.en: Update immediately per sample, without storing it — resource-friendly and privacy-preserving
a4be4e8a13.zh: 每个样本立即更新而无需存储，节省资源且保护隐私

871b4b4628.en: Promise: on-board learning on phones & microcontrollers; micro/nano-second decisions; democratize deep RL to billions of devices
871b4b4628.zh: 前景：在手机和微控制器上进行端侧学习；微秒/纳秒级决策；让深度强化学习惠及数十亿台设备

44c0c37adc.en: Batch RL's success is credited to data efficiency: reusing samples and averaging i.i.d. gradients for reliable updates
44c0c37adc.zh: 批量强化学习的成功被归功于数据效率：重复使用样本，并对独立同分布（i.i.d.）梯度取平均以获得可靠的更新

c4e34c4b9b.en: Streaming RL's failure is blamed on sample inefficiency, instability, and hard step-size choice (per-sample gradient outliers)
c4e34c4b9b.zh: 流式强化学习的失败被归咎于样本效率低、不稳定以及步长难以选择（单样本梯度存在离群值）

91a1642fcc.en: Stability: a step-size-controlling optimizer, reward scaling, observation normalization
91a1642fcc.zh: 稳定性：可控制步长的优化器、奖励缩放、观测归一化

bb8ddbb71d.en: Trainability: fix the pre-activation distribution with layer norm
bb8ddbb71d.zh: 可训练性：用 layer norm 固定预激活分布

d1cd35fafa.en: Sample efficiency: eligibility traces + sparse initialization (Stream-x)
d1cd35fafa.zh: 样本效率：资格迹 + 稀疏初始化（Stream-x）

c1e7fe12e3.en: Batch vs streaming deep-RL setups — streaming learns sample-by-sample, with no replay buffer.
c1e7fe12e3.zh: 批量与流式深度强化学习的设置对比：流式逐样本学习，没有回放缓冲区。

536149b318.zh: 持续学习在哪里带来回报

162f9aabef.zh: {1}应用{/1} · 持续学习演讲 · 行业场景

2b7fa72cae.en: Adapt to user preferences over time without manual updates
2b7fa72cae.zh: 随时间适应用户偏好，无需手动更新

3d0389ee85.en: Learn and anticipate changing user habits (e.g. a HarmonyOS smart home)
3d0389ee85.zh: 学习并预判用户不断变化的习惯（例如 HarmonyOS 智能家居）

9d8b579807.en: Continuously improve diagnosis & treatment recommendations as more patient data arrives
9d8b579807.zh: 随着更多患者数据到来，持续改进诊断和治疗建议

53fe6388b7.en: Tailor treatments over time from a live stream (e.g. a watch / fit band)
53fe6388b7.zh: 基于实时数据流（例如手表 / 健身手环）随时间调整治疗方案

0299095379.en: Gaming: adapt difficulty and NPC behavior to player skill
0299095379.zh: 游戏：根据玩家水平调整难度和 NPC 行为

638025c62d.en: Finance: adjust trading and portfolio strategies to evolving markets
638025c62d.zh: 金融：根据不断演变的市场调整交易和投资组合策略

20297dc23b.en: Agriculture: optimize crop management across changing climate, soil and seasons
20297dc23b.zh: 农业：在气候、土壤和季节变化中优化作物管理

376530068a.zh: 为什么这里需要持续学习

04edfed14d.en: Any system in a dynamic environment benefits from real-time adaptation — no periodic re-training
04edfed14d.zh: 任何处于动态环境中的系统都能从实时适应中受益，无需定期重新训练

b7dc4b52e2.en: Evolve progressively, avoiding costly full re-training cycles (model drift / degradation)
b7dc4b52e2.zh: 渐进式演进，避免代价高昂的完整重新训练周期（模型漂移 / 退化）

0ce736dbe2.en: Fits memory- and resource-constrained embedded & IoT devices — incremental, low-resource updates
0ce736dbe2.zh: 适合内存和资源受限的嵌入式与物联网设备，只需增量式、低资源的更新

fb6dfe926e.en: Personalized health on a continual stream — a wearable refining its models as data arrives.
fb6dfe926e.zh: 基于持续数据流的个性化健康：可穿戴设备随数据到来不断优化其模型。

24aed9d87d.en: Smart-home / IoT devices that keep adapting to changing user habits.
24aed9d87d.zh: 不断适应用户习惯变化的智能家居 / 物联网设备。

74f83a97c6.zh: 持续学习的挑战与局限

492aa2d425.zh: {1}挑战与局限{/1} · 持续学习演讲

374bfe26c6.en: Complexity of implementation — must manage knowledge retention while integrating new information
374bfe26c6.zh: 实现复杂：必须在整合新信息的同时管理知识保留

f05abc0478.en: Data management — relies on a continuous data stream, often infeasible (e.g. autonomous vehicles need manual labeled data)
f05abc0478.zh: 数据管理：依赖连续数据流，而这往往不可行（例如自动驾驶车辆需要人工标注的数据）

1f415b99c9.en: Overhead in training time and compute to accommodate ongoing updates and refinements
1f415b99c9.zh: 为适应持续的更新和改进，训练时间和算力都有额外开销

8c66f01dbb.en: Task & data complexity — as tasks grow, model architecture may need to expand, complicating training and inference
8c66f01dbb.zh: 任务与数据复杂度：随着任务增多，模型架构可能需要扩展，使训练和推理更加复杂

a4423eebe2.en: Catastrophic forgetting — forgets earlier tasks/classes when trained on new data, especially when data is non-sequential
a4423eebe2.zh: 灾难性遗忘：在新数据上训练时会遗忘早先的任务/类别，数据非顺序时尤其明显

f8a97125f1.en: Performance degradation in non-stationary environments where distributions change frequently or unpredictably
f8a97125f1.zh: 在分布频繁或不可预测地变化的非平稳环境中，性能会下降

a8e9d99125.en: Risk of overfitting to recent data while failing to generalize across all tasks or classes
a8e9d99125.zh: 存在过拟合近期数据的风险，同时无法在所有任务或类别上泛化

c10cef9750.en: Real-time adaptation is technically challenging when immediate updates on new data are required
c10cef9750.zh: 当需要对新数据立即更新时，实时适应在技术上具有挑战性

228a19cafa.en: Limited benchmarking & evaluation standards — hard to compare approaches or judge effectiveness
228a19cafa.zh: 基准测试和评估标准有限：难以比较不同方法或判断其有效性

223b93fa26.en: No validation for safety-critical systems — run-time learning has no controlled-environment validation; dangerous for autonomous vehicles
223b93fa26.zh: 安全关键系统缺乏确认手段：运行时学习没有受控环境下的确认；对自动驾驶车辆很危险

dedd809946.en: Growing demand for autonomous, smart systems that learn continually from their environment.
dedd809946.zh: 对能从环境中持续学习的自主智能系统的需求不断增长。

e209dcb1ca.en: A shift toward real-time adaptation — fewer manual interventions and re-training cycles.
e209dcb1ca.zh: 向实时适应转变，减少人工干预和重新训练周期。

9b85af2891.en: Edge & IoT push toward lightweight, resource-efficient continual learning on-device.
9b85af2891.zh: 边缘和物联网推动轻量、资源高效的端侧持续学习。

2e34f1b4fe.en: Adaptive, lifelong-learning systems that evolve without forgetting — like human learning.
2e34f1b4fe.zh: 能够自适应、终身学习且不遗忘的系统，就像人类的学习一样。

58b55cb188.en: Resource-efficient, scalable AI that runs well under tight compute and memory budgets.
58b55cb188.zh: 资源高效、可扩展的 AI，在算力和内存预算紧张的情况下也能良好运行。

4941f69024.en: Real-time decision-making and genuine human-AI collaboration from live feedback.
4941f69024.zh: 基于实时反馈的实时决策和真正的人机协作。

9a0f1b641c.en: Reduced retraining cost and a smaller carbon footprint — cheaper, greener AI.
9a0f1b641c.zh: 降低重新训练成本、减少碳足迹，让 AI 更便宜、更环保。

a7f382341d.en: Scalability across devices (IoT, edge) and minimized catastrophic forgetting.
a7f382341d.zh: 可跨设备（物联网、边缘）扩展，并将灾难性遗忘降到最低。

6e64ecbd06.en: A strategic edge for autonomous systems and clear cross-sector market differentiation.
6e64ecbd06.zh: 为自主系统带来战略优势，并在各行业形成清晰的市场差异化。

c50ee71a17.en:
Trends

  • Growing demand for autonomous, smart systems that learn continually from their environment.
  • A shift toward real-time adaptation — fewer manual interventions and re-training cycles.
  • Edge & IoT push toward lightweight, resource-efficient continual learning on-device.

Vision

  • Adaptive, lifelong-learning systems that evolve without forgetting — like human learning.
  • Resource-efficient, scalable AI that runs well under tight compute and memory budgets.
  • Real-time decision-making and genuine human-AI collaboration from live feedback.

Implications for us

  • Reduced retraining cost and a smaller carbon footprint — cheaper, greener AI.
  • Scalability across devices (IoT, edge) and minimized catastrophic forgetting.
  • A strategic edge for autonomous systems and clear cross-sector market differentiation.
c50ee71a17.zh:
趋势

  • 对能从环境中持续学习的自主智能系统的需求不断增长。
  • 向实时适应转变，减少人工干预和重新训练周期。
  • 边缘和物联网推动轻量、资源高效的端侧持续学习。

愿景

  • 能够自适应、终身学习且不遗忘的系统，就像人类的学习一样。
  • 资源高效、可扩展的 AI，在算力和内存预算紧张的情况下也能良好运行。
  • 基于实时反馈的实时决策和真正的人机协作。

对我们的启示

  • 降低重新训练成本、减少碳足迹，让 AI 更便宜、更环保。
  • 可跨设备（物联网、边缘）扩展，并将灾难性遗忘降到最低。
  • 为自主系统带来战略优势，并在各行业形成清晰的市场差异化。

f6b15d2eaa.en: About: An invitational retreat of the OpenMind Research Institute — a Canadian non-profit, fully virtual organization whose roadmap is the Alberta Plan for AI Research. This report distills one talk, “Continual Learning,” topic by topic.
f6b15d2eaa.zh: 关于：这是 OpenMind Research Institute 的一场邀请制研讨会。该机构是加拿大的非营利、完全线上组织，路线图为 Alberta Plan for AI Research。本报告按主题梳理了一场演讲“Continual Learning”。

1718a60951.en: • Canadian non-profit, fully virtual research institute
1718a60951.zh: • 加拿大非营利、完全线上的研究机构

1a2493cc13.en: • Motto: understand minds well enough to build some — how minds arise from a stream of experience
1a2493cc13.zh: • 宗旨：深入理解心智，进而构建心智，即心智如何从经验流中产生

1adf0e6ac2.en: • Roadmap: the Alberta Plan for AI Research
1adf0e6ac2.zh: • 路线图：Alberta Plan for AI Research

d94a9e251f.en: • Objective: do fundamental research and share it openly with the world
d94a9e251f.zh: • 目标：开展基础研究，并向全世界公开分享

f2f0ea162d.en: • Super-intelligent agents and augmented humans will bring great benefits to the world
f2f0ea162d.zh: • 超级智能的智能体和增强的人类将为世界带来巨大益处

6937b03ffb.en: • The most significant AI advancements are still ahead of us
6937b03ffb.zh: • AI 最重大的进展还在前方

2ddeb9983c.en: • AI development is more of a marathon than a sprint
2ddeb9983c.zh: • AI 的发展更像一场马拉松，而不是短跑

9e43e06ea9.en: • Reinforcement learning (RL) — not generative AI — is the key path to developing intelligent agents
9e43e06ea9.zh: • 强化学习（RL）而非生成式 AI，是开发智能体的关键路径

cf6b6df3a7.en: • The main challenge is the lack of effective learning algorithms
cf6b6df3a7.zh: • 主要挑战是缺乏有效的学习算法

96d25fe4a6.en: INSIGHT 02 · Minds, and why continual learning
96d25fe4a6.zh: 洞察 02 · 心智，以及为什么需要持续学习

e7709e9fe6.en: Continual Learning (talk) · McCarthy · Sutton — ‘reward is enough’
e7709e9fe6.zh: Continual Learning (talk) · McCarthy · Sutton — ‘reward is enough’

3b03a69aee.en: • Intelligence is the computational part of the ability to achieve goals (McCarthy & Sutton)
3b03a69aee.zh: • 智能是实现目标能力中的计算部分（McCarthy 和 Sutton）

4019fab2af.en: • Reward hypothesis: goals & purposes = maximizing the expected cumulative scalar reward
4019fab2af.zh: • 奖励假设：目标与意图 = 最大化期望累积标量奖励

a1d0513502.en: • Reward-is-enough hypothesis: intelligence and its abilities subserve reward maximization
a1d0513502.zh: • 奖励足够假设：智能及其各项能力都服务于奖励最大化

d000df7577.en: • Biological minds naturally adapt behavior to goals in complex, dynamic environments
d000df7577.zh: • 生物心智能在复杂、动态的环境中自然地根据目标调整行为

05be56820c.en: • Society is comfortable with the adaptive behavior of animals
05be56820c.zh: • 社会对动物的适应性行为习以为常

9e064ddf27.en: • Most ML / engineering systems are fixed and non-adaptive, built on static models of predefined domains
9e064ddf27.zh: • 大多数机器学习 / 工程系统是固定的、不具适应性的，建立在预定义领域的静态模型之上

c8ea6e1948.en: • Biological minds adapt within one ongoing, open stream of experience — not independent data inputs
c8ea6e1948.zh: • 生物心智在一条持续、开放的经验流中进行适应，而不是处理相互独立的数据输入

758cb266ad.en: • Most ML assumes i.i.d. data, making it hard to adapt to real-time, open-world settings
758cb266ad.zh: • 大多数机器学习假设数据独立同分布（i.i.d.），因此难以适应实时、开放世界的环境

b2ff8e97a5.en: • Open-world learning needs online learning, incremental updates and real-time adaptability — not captured by current ML theory
b2ff8e97a5.zh: • 开放世界学习需要在线学习、增量更新和实时适应能力，而这些是当前机器学习理论尚未涵盖的

44fe2ebe29.en: INSIGHT 03 · Minds, and why continual learning
44fe2ebe29.zh: 洞察 03 · 心智，以及为什么需要持续学习

5ce0188350.en: • Constant learning: a train phase, then a frozen model used for test
5ce0188350.zh: • 恒定学习：先有训练阶段，然后使用冻结的模型进行测试

11f29b171c.en: • Continual learning: the agent stays in the state–action–reward loop and keeps learning past ‘test’
11f29b171c.zh: • 持续学习：智能体始终处于状态–动作–奖励循环中，在“测试”之后仍继续学习

00308b7879.zh: 能学习和适应的智能体

72146c94b0.en: • Learning/adapting agents face non-stationary environments — changing data, policies and value functions
72146c94b0.zh: • 学习/适应的智能体面对的是非平稳环境，其数据、策略和价值函数都在变化

4d43c7ef1a.en: • Reinforcement learning can handle some degree of non-stationarity naturally
4d43c7ef1a.zh: • 强化学习能够自然地处理一定程度的非平稳性

a8c8674b12.en: • Continual learning in open environments is a central challenge for minds
a8c8674b12.zh: • 开放环境中的持续学习是心智面临的核心挑战

42b035deb4.en: INSIGHT 04 · Agents in a big world
42b035deb4.zh: 洞察 04 · 大世界中的智能体

d0814945f5.en: Continual Learning (talk) · the Alberta Plan agent model
d0814945f5.zh: Continual Learning (talk) · Alberta Plan 的智能体模型

fb9b3fe42e.en: • Perception — produces the state representation used by all other components
fb9b3fe42e.zh: • 感知：生成供所有其他组件使用的状态表示

8940608108.en: • Reactive policies — quickly produce actions that achieve high reward or features
8940608108.zh: • 反应式策略：快速产生能获得高奖励或特征的动作

285a37af3c.en: • Value functions — evaluate how well things are going and change the policy (learning)
285a37af3c.zh: • 价值函数：评估事情进展得如何，并改变策略（学习）

f8e5e7b839.en: • Transition model — predict consequences of alternative choices and change the policy (planning)
f8e5e7b839.zh: • 转移模型：预测不同选择的后果，并改变策略（规划）

37e4e4e858.en: • Continual supervised representation / feature finding; continual generalized value-function prediction
37e4e4e858.zh: • 持续的监督式表示 / 特征发现；持续的广义价值函数预测

c518a6c1e8.en: • Continual actor-critic control; planning with reward, search control and exploration
c518a6c1e8.zh: • 持续的 actor-critic 控制；结合奖励、搜索控制和探索进行规划

d4a7312720.en: • One-step model-based RL with continual function approximation
d4a7312720.zh: • 采用持续函数逼近的单步基于模型的强化学习（RL）

36861beb95.en: • STOMP — Stochastic Trajectory Optimization for Motion Planning
36861beb95.zh: • STOMP — 用于运动规划的随机轨迹优化

015f40a055.en: • Intelligence amplification — enhancing human decision-making with AI
015f40a055.zh: • 智能增强 — 用 AI 提升人类决策

5ea0b07907.en: INSIGHT 05 · Agents in a big world
5ea0b07907.zh: 洞察 05 · 大世界中的智能体

a8bf8887a0.en: K. Javed & R. Sutton · Big World Hypothesis, 2024
a8bf8887a0.zh: K. Javed & R. Sutton · Big World Hypothesis, 2024

a7767e854d.en: • The agent is constrained relative to the world: an information-capacity limit = the entropy of agent state, in bits
a7767e854d.zh: • 智能体相对于世界是受限的：信息容量上限 = 智能体状态的熵，以比特计

71955dd9d5.en: • Traditional theory: hone in on good actions and refine over time, with vanishing benefit to exploration
71955dd9d5.zh: • 传统理论：锁定好的动作并随时间不断优化，探索的收益逐渐消失

3af13b01a6.en: • Small agent, big world ⇒ want more capacity; non-stationary exploration ⇒ acquire info relevant to the future, forget the rest
3af13b01a6.zh: • 小智能体、大世界 ⇒ 需要更大容量；非平稳探索 ⇒ 获取与未来相关的信息，遗忘其余

bb8c671186.en: • Model what matters for decisions: Value-Aware (VAML) & Policy-Aware (PAML) model learning, distributional-equivalent variants
bb8c671186.zh: • 只对决策重要的部分建模：价值感知（VAML）与策略感知（PAML）模型学习，以及分布等价的变体

be3c0df493.en: • Much recent work: Predictron, VPN, TreeQN, GAMPS, value-targeted regression, muZero, value-equivalent sampling

d68942e4e8.en: • Continual Knowledge Re-Grounding (KnoReG): benefit from an approximate model, then continually correct it against the real world (OS-VI update)
d68942e4e8.zh: • 持续知识再锚定（KnoReG）：先从近似模型中获益，再持续对照真实世界修正它（OS-VI 更新）

e416660eb8.en: • There are new ways an approximate model of the world can help a small agent
e416660eb8.zh: • 近似的世界模型能以新的方式帮助小智能体

93c5c95316.en: • You are not limited to choosing only an inaccurate or only an accurate model
93c5c95316.zh: • 你不必只在不准确的模型和准确的模型之间二选一

7c1668b66b.en: INSIGHT 06 · Agents in a big world
7c1668b66b.zh: 洞察 06 · 大世界中的智能体

7bc378d1a0.en: R. Sutton — ‘The Bitter Lesson’ · vs the Big World Hypothesis
7bc378d1a0.zh: R. Sutton — “The Bitter Lesson” · 对比 Big World Hypothesis

8002a31b4e.en: • A trade-off between generality and sample efficiency
8002a31b4e.zh: • 通用性与样本效率之间的权衡

ed4fc50084.en: • You can improve efficiency by adding bias, at the cost of generality
ed4fc50084.zh: • 可以通过加入偏置来提高效率，代价是通用性

bc0421c61d.en: • RL defines an extremely general set of problems
bc0421c61d.zh: • 强化学习（RL）定义了一类极为通用的问题

0f24c16f94.en: • Add bias to the agent — in conflict with the Bitter Lesson and the Big World Hypothesis
0f24c16f94.zh: • 给智能体加入偏置 — 与 Bitter Lesson 和 Big World Hypothesis 相冲突

35f12997cb.en: • Use more computation — in conflict with the Big World Hypothesis
35f12997cb.zh: • 使用更多计算 — 与 Big World Hypothesis 相冲突

c5ade6bbe1.en: • Building in knowledge helps short-term and is satisfying, but plateaus and even inhibits progress long-term
c5ade6bbe1.zh: • 内置知识短期内有帮助，也令人满意，但长期会进入平台期，甚至阻碍进步

4abf54216f.en: • Breakthroughs eventually arrive from scaling computation via search and learning
4abf54216f.zh: • 突破最终来自通过搜索和学习扩大计算规模

b4eab2d174.en: • The environment is significantly larger and more complex than the agent acting within it
b4eab2d174.zh: • 环境比身处其中的智能体大得多、复杂得多

d5193fc2d2.en: • As compute grows, environment complexity grows too — the world stays much larger than the agent (Javed & Sutton, 2024)
d5193fc2d2.zh: • 随着算力增长，环境复杂度也随之增长 — 世界始终远大于智能体（Javed & Sutton, 2024）

25f0043cdf.zh: 洞察 07 · 从批处理到流式

d985f8734e.en: M. Elsayed et al. · “Streaming Deep RL Finally Works”, 2024
d985f8734e.zh: M. Elsayed et al. · “Streaming Deep RL Finally Works”, 2024

2ebe7c1476.zh: 流式方法与批处理方法

b1624baba0.en: • Classic streaming — TD(λ), Q(λ), SARSA(λ), AC(λ) — do not work with deep networks
b1624baba0.zh: • 经典流式方法 — TD(λ)、Q(λ)、SARSA(λ)、AC(λ) — 在深度网络上不起作用

f1077b7ff6.en: • Batch — PPO, SAC, DQN, Rainbow — do work with deep networks, but need replay buffers
f1077b7ff6.zh: • 批处理方法 — PPO、SAC、DQN、Rainbow — 在深度网络上有效，但需要回放缓冲区

bff02891de.en: • Natural intelligence processes experience as a continuous stream — sense, act and learn moment-by-moment
bff02891de.zh: • 自然智能把经验当作连续的流来处理 — 时时刻刻感知、行动和学习

a08c8fb6a7.en: • Update immediately per sample, without storing it — resource-friendly and privacy-preserving
a08c8fb6a7.zh: • 每个样本立即更新，无需存储 — 节省资源，保护隐私

0c17f26c7b.en: • Promise: on-board learning on phones & microcontrollers; micro/nano-second decisions; democratize deep RL to billions of devices
0c17f26c7b.zh: • 前景：在手机和微控制器上进行端侧学习；微秒/纳秒级决策；让深度强化学习（RL）惠及数十亿设备

bd5e0ab80a.en: • Batch RL's success is credited to data efficiency: reusing samples and averaging i.i.d. gradients for reliable updates
bd5e0ab80a.zh: • 批处理 RL 的成功被归因于数据效率：复用样本，并对独立同分布（i.i.d.）梯度取平均以获得可靠的更新

980dc020ce.en: • Streaming RL's failure is blamed on sample inefficiency, instability, and hard step-size choice (per-sample gradient outliers)
980dc020ce.zh: • 流式 RL 的失败被归咎于样本效率低、不稳定以及步长难以选择（单样本梯度的离群值）

29196cedfd.en: • Stability: a step-size-controlling optimizer, reward scaling, observation normalization
29196cedfd.zh: • 稳定性：控制步长的优化器、奖励缩放、观测归一化

fd9a4ecc6b.en: • Trainability: fix the pre-activation distribution with layer norm
fd9a4ecc6b.zh: • 可训练性：用层归一化修正预激活分布

ef6ea1c3e1.en: • Sample efficiency: eligibility traces + sparse initialization (Stream-x)
ef6ea1c3e1.zh: • 样本效率：资格迹 + 稀疏初始化（Stream-x）

d22075f63e.en: Applications · Continual Learning talk · industry scenarios
d22075f63e.zh: 应用 · 持续学习演讲 · 行业场景

cc034fddb0.en: • Adapt to user preferences over time without manual updates
cc034fddb0.zh: • 随时间适应用户偏好，无需手动更新

305d3447d6.en: • Learn and anticipate changing user habits (e.g. a HarmonyOS smart home)
305d3447d6.zh: • 学习并预判不断变化的用户习惯（如 HarmonyOS 智能家居）

7fb6f3610e.en: • Continuously improve diagnosis & treatment recommendations as more patient data arrives
7fb6f3610e.zh: • 随着更多患者数据到来，持续改进诊断和治疗建议

5c8fd73e84.en: • Tailor treatments over time from a live stream (e.g. a watch / fit band)
5c8fd73e84.zh: • 基于实时数据流持续定制治疗方案（如手表/运动手环）

0bedf32c27.en: • Gaming: adapt difficulty and NPC behavior to player skill
0bedf32c27.zh: • 游戏：根据玩家水平调整难度和 NPC 行为

ba97d73312.en: • Finance: adjust trading and portfolio strategies to evolving markets
ba97d73312.zh: • 金融：让交易和投资组合策略适应不断变化的市场

d97cf67455.en: • Agriculture: optimize crop management across changing climate, soil and seasons
d97cf67455.zh: • 农业：在气候、土壤和季节变化中优化作物管理

cff18ccec5.zh: 为什么这里需要持续学习

97af70ce86.en: • Any system in a dynamic environment benefits from real-time adaptation — no periodic re-training
97af70ce86.zh: • 任何处于动态环境中的系统都能从实时适应中受益 — 无需定期重新训练

2a04722167.en: • Evolve progressively, avoiding costly full re-training cycles (model drift / degradation)
2a04722167.zh: • 逐步演进，避免代价高昂的完整重新训练周期（模型漂移/退化）

cc7924daf8.en: • Fits memory- and resource-constrained embedded & IoT devices — incremental, low-resource updates
cc7924daf8.zh: • 适合内存和资源受限的嵌入式与物联网设备 — 增量式、低资源更新

05bd7bcfa0.zh: 挑战与局限 · 持续学习演讲

cfe220b28d.en: • Complexity of implementation — must manage knowledge retention while integrating new information
cfe220b28d.zh: • 实现复杂 — 必须在整合新信息的同时管理知识留存

70b070f049.en: • Data management — relies on a continuous data stream, often infeasible (e.g. autonomous vehicles need manual labeled data)
70b070f049.zh: • 数据管理 — 依赖连续的数据流，而这往往不可行（例如自动驾驶车辆需要人工标注的数据）

3ff53e27c1.en: • Overhead in training time and compute to accommodate ongoing updates and refinements
3ff53e27c1.zh: • 为适应持续的更新和改进，训练时间和算力都有额外开销

ae6e48bd0f.en: • Task & data complexity — as tasks grow, model architecture may need to expand, complicating training and inference
ae6e48bd0f.zh: • 任务与数据复杂 — 随着任务增多，模型架构可能需要扩展，使训练和推理更复杂

9c03b506dc.en: • Catastrophic forgetting — forgets earlier tasks/classes when trained on new data, especially when data is non-sequential
9c03b506dc.zh: • 灾难性遗忘 — 用新数据训练时会遗忘早先的任务/类别，数据非顺序时尤其明显

32c0884480.en: • Performance degradation in non-stationary environments where distributions change frequently or unpredictably
32c0884480.zh: • 在分布频繁或不可预测变化的非平稳环境中性能下降

d6bd689115.en: • Risk of overfitting to recent data while failing to generalize across all tasks or classes
d6bd689115.zh: • 有对近期数据过拟合的风险，导致无法在所有任务或类别上泛化

c261492027.en: • Real-time adaptation is technically challenging when immediate updates on new data are required
c261492027.zh: • 当需要对新数据立即更新时，实时适应在技术上具有挑战

08940a6541.en: • Limited benchmarking & evaluation standards — hard to compare approaches or judge effectiveness
08940a6541.zh: • 基准测试和评估标准有限 — 难以比较各种方法或判断其有效性

257543750e.en: • No validation for safety-critical systems — run-time learning has no controlled-environment validation; dangerous for autonomous vehicles
257543750e.zh: • 安全关键系统缺少确认手段 — 运行时学习没有受控环境下的确认；对自动驾驶车辆很危险

bca7c4853c.en: • Growing demand for autonomous, smart systems that learn continually from their environment.
bca7c4853c.zh: • 对能从环境中持续学习的自主智能系统，需求不断增长。

ef6dff9d4d.en: • A shift toward real-time adaptation — fewer manual interventions and re-training cycles.
ef6dff9d4d.zh: • 转向实时适应 — 减少人工干预和重新训练周期。

368e545740.en: • Edge & IoT push toward lightweight, resource-efficient continual learning on-device.
368e545740.zh: • 边缘和物联网推动轻量、节省资源的端侧持续学习。

61b594f965.en: • Adaptive, lifelong-learning systems that evolve without forgetting — like human learning.
61b594f965.zh: • 自适应的终身学习系统，像人类学习一样不断演进而不遗忘。

263e843f2a.en: • Resource-efficient, scalable AI that runs well under tight compute and memory budgets.
263e843f2a.zh: • 资源高效、可扩展的 AI，在算力和内存预算紧张时也能良好运行。

83e0457bc4.en: • Real-time decision-making and genuine human-AI collaboration from live feedback.
83e0457bc4.zh: • 基于实时反馈的实时决策，以及真正的人机协作。

62882d1169.en: • Reduced retraining cost and a smaller carbon footprint — cheaper, greener AI.
62882d1169.zh: • 降低重新训练成本，减少碳足迹 — 更便宜、更绿色的 AI。

00982fbc4c.en: • Scalability across devices (IoT, edge) and minimized catastrophic forgetting.
00982fbc4c.zh: • 可跨设备（物联网、边缘）扩展，并将灾难性遗忘降到最低。

11bbcc18a7.en: • A strategic edge for autonomous systems and clear cross-sector market differentiation.
11bbcc18a7.zh: • 为自主系统带来战略优势，并形成清晰的跨行业市场差异化。
